data.name: Negative Energy Font
data.description: You can unleash a wave of negative energy. You must choose to deal %1d6 points of negative energy damage to living creatures or to heal undead creatures of %1d6 points of damage. Creatures that take damage from channeled energy receive a DC %2 Will save to halve the damage. You can use this ability %3 times per day.|HierophantChannelDice|HierophantChannelDC|HierophantChannelTimes
